entries.note: Received from the sender at the office the scan names. Once the item moved, the same wording is its sender's post taking it back, which the adapter reads as in transit.
Processed at the site the scan names: a post office, a regional hub or the international exchange office in Bucharest (BSI).
Left the site the scan names after "Plecat din".
Sent abroad from the international exchange office; the tracker follows an item only while it is in Romania.
Arrived from abroad at the international exchange office; seen on an item coming back to its sender.
Sent back to its sender; a later delivery reaches the sender.

entries.wording: Programat pentru predare incepand cu aceasta data
entries.note: The Track&Trace guide explains that a notice follows and the item can be collected at the office the scan names from that date.
Handed to the recipient; it names no site.
